item.title: Trump calls death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei the ‘single greatest chance for the Iranian people to take back their Country’
item.description: The assassination of the second leader of the Islamic Republic, who had no designated successor, would throw its future into doubt and raise the prospect of a protracted conflict.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will bomb Iran uninterrupted ‘as long as necessary’ to achieve peace in Mideast and the world after confirming Khamenei’s death
item.description: Trump signaled even more expansive ambitions and longevity for his attacks on Iran.

item.title: Pentagon chief blocks officers from attending Ivy League schools and other top universities, including partners on AI and space
item.description: "We will no longer invest in institutions that fail to sharpen our leaders' warfighting capabilities or that undermine the very values they are sworn to defend."

item.title: Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei dies after major attack by Israel and the U.S., Iranian state media confirms
item.description: Neither Iranian state television nor the state-run IRNA news agency reported a cause of death for the 86-year-old.

item.title: American, Israeli strike on Iran came 2 days after latest talks, as theocracy struggled with nationwide protests
item.description: The nationwide protests began over the economy but turned into anti-government ones. The UN Security Council met in an urgent session.

item.title: Russia accuses America of ‘pre-planned and unprovoked act of armed aggression’ against Iran
item.description: The Arab League called the Iranian attacks “a blatant violation of the sovereignty of countries that advocate for peace and strive for stability.”

item.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene rips Iran strikes as Trump betraying America First: ‘It’s always a lie and it’s always America Last’
item.description: In 10 years, Trump went from criticizing regime change in the Middle East to urging Iranians to "seize control of your destiny."

item.title: A month before Iran strikes, Trump told Iranian protesters help was on the way amid a government crackdown
item.description: Human rights groups reported that thousands were killed in the Iranian crackdown.

item.title: Thomas Massie among few Republicans to criticize Trump over war powers: ‘This is not ‘America First”
item.description: Key members of Congress are demanding a swift vote on a war powers resolution that would restrain President Donald Trump's military attack on Iran.

item.title: Israel, U.S. stiff-arm U.N. during emergency Security Council meeting
item.description: Iran's ambassador said the airstrikes have killed and injured hundreds of Iranian civilians, which he called a war crime and a crime against humanity.
